claim: The Str8 case (`case <= byte.MaxValue`) was removed from the string header writer. Strings of 32..255 bytes now fall through to the Str16 branch, so the encoding is non-minimal and larger than before. This is a wire-format change that has nothing to do with the analyzer requirement. It is also a regression for any consumer or interop that expects the compact Str8 form. It inflates payloads and can break byte-exact round-trip and format tests. The effect is a size and format regression, not a memory-safety hole, so I rate it high as a breaking change.
